PLAN "12-week Bodyweight Strength for Beginner (Home, Minimal Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper focus - Pull & Push":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Australian_pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Incline_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Doorway_negative_pull_up 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Split_squat (rear foot elevated optional) 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Single_leg_Romanian_deadlift (bodyweight) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Side_plank 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body - Skill & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Assisted_pull_up (band substitute: foot-assisted) 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x20..40s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper focus - Pull & Push":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Australian_pull_up 4x7..9 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Incline_push_up 4x9..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Doorway_negative_pull_up 3x6..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x35..50s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Split_squat 4x9..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Single_leg_Romanian_deadlift (bodyweight) 3x9..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Side_plank 3x25..35s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body - Skill & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Assisted_pull_up 4x6..9 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x7..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 3x9..11 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x25..45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper focus - Progression":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up_progression (attempt strict) 5x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push_up (standard) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Inverted_row_to_chest_contact 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x30..50s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower & Core - Load & Control":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_progression (assisted) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge_single_leg (assisted) 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_with_shoulder_tap 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - Strength & Volume":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Assisted_pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_to_plank 3x20..40s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper - Consolidation":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up_progression (strict emphasis) 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Diamond_push_up (or close) 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Australian_pull_up_feet_elevated 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Side_plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower - Consolidation":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_progression (less assistance) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge_single_leg 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl_eccentric (assisted on knees) 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x40..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - Test & Work":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 7m
        main straight_sets:
          Max_assisted_pull_up_sets 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push_up_variation_choice 4x8..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x30..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper strength focus":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up (attempt sets) 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Archer_push_up_progression 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Inverted_row_feet_elevated 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_to_rock 3x30..50s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower strength & control":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat_progression 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl (assisted) 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Elevated_feet_glute_bridge_single_leg 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_with_leg_lift 3x40..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - Volume":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x40..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper - Progression & Intensity":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          One_arm_push_up_assist (incline) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Australian_pull_up_feet_elevated 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Side_plank_with_reach 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower - Strength & Stability":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat_progression 4x7..9 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Nordic_curl (less assistance) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Reverse_lunge_jump_control (no impact: slow) 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x50..70s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - Strength Endurance":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Diamond_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_to_plank 3x40..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper - Advanced bodyweight":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up (chest-to-bar attempt) 5x4..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Archer_push_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Inverted_row_one_arm_assist 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          L-sit_tuck_hold 3x15..30s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower - Power & Control":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Single_leg_glute_bridge_hold 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_with_shoulder_tap 3x50..70s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body - Mixed Strength":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Decline_push_up_variation 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x10..14 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x45..75s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper - Peak Week":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          One_arm_push_up_assist 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Australian_pull_up_feet_elevated 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          L-sit_hold 3x20..40s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower - Peak Week":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Elevated_single_leg_glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x60..90s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body - Peak Week":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x60..90s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Consolidate & Test" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper - Strength Maintenance":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push_up_variation (chosen) 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          L-sit_tuck_hold 3x20..40s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower - Strength Maintenance":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge_single_leg 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - Volume & Worksets":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Decline_push_up 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper - Intensity":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Max_effort_pull_up_sets 6x4..8 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          One_arm_push_up_assist 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Australian_pull_up_feet_elevated 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          L-sit_hold 3x25..45s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower - Intensity":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pistol_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Nordic_curl 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_with_leg_lift 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - Prep for Test":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push_up (max quality) 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Single_leg_glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload - Light Strength":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up_assisted 4x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Incline_push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Bodyweight_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload - Mobility & Control":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Side_plank 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload - Prep":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Assisted_pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Push_up_variation 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 6m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Test - Strength Checks":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Max_pull_up_sets 6xmax rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Max_push_up_sets 4xmax rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          Max_pistol_assist_sets 4xmax rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Max_plank_hold 3xmax rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          light_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          Mobility_flow 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing 10m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Final Consolidation":
        warmup:
          dynamic_movement 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Pull_up 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push_up_choice 4x10..20 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hollow_body_hold 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 6m
